text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
We had so much fun here, didn't we?
It'd be rad if we could all hang out again next year.
That said, I gotta go extra hard on work.
choice_data_list: We're BFFs, so it'll be okay.
You'll be on an even bigger stage next year.
I'll keep my schedule empty for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイ楽しかったねー！
来年もみんなで遊びにきたいな。
そのためにも
うちもっと仕事頑張んなきゃ。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
For sure.
We all gotta plan ahead first!
Would be a hella nightmare if any of us penciled something else in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っしょ？
とりま、
みんなの予定を今から抑えておかないと！
ダブルブッキングしちゃったら、
マジ笑えないし～！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Feels like I can really pull it off when you put it that way.
You know what? If you believe in me that much, then I'll definitely make it.
Talk the talk, walk the walk!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイがそう言ってくれるなら、
うちなんか立てそうな気がするかも？
てゆか、
ヒデサイが期待してくれてるんだから、
絶対立っちゃうし。
ゆーげんじっこーってやつなんでよろ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
For real? Thanks a ton!
Wow though, you've really got that much free time?
That's kinda depressing, so I'll help fill the rest of your summer schedule.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジ？　
うれしー！
てか、
ヒデサイってそんな暇なの、
なんかかわいそーじゃね？
残りの夏休みも
うちがヒデサイの予定
埋めてあげるよ。
